subject: general
question: In which of the following states is the ‘Mim Kut’ festival traditionally celebrated?
solution:
The Correct Answer is **__Mizoram__**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The Mim Kut festival is a traditional Festival of **Mizoram, India.**
 
• It is celebrated during March after completion of their most arduous task of jhum operation.
 
• It is a festival of spring celebrated with great favor.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
